fact: The DRC-Burundi fibre-optic interconnection project, a joint initiative between the two countries, had its memorandum of understanding adopted by Burundi's Council of Ministers on 8 May 2024, per ABP.

AfriqueITNews reports that on 20 October 2025 the heads of Congo's SOCOF and Tanzania's TTCL, with a Tanzanian ministry representative, made official the Kalemie-Kigoma lake cable, with works due in Q1 2026 and service by end 2027.
